title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
topics: Relief grooves for grinding zones (UNI4386 comparison)
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must follow UNI4386 standard or TRASMITAL specifications
Groove dimensions vary by diameter range: 18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm
Relief grooves for thread must be made where the thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in details in drawing
Thread relief groove depth proportional to pitch P: ratio R = 1.2 to 2.0 times pitch
dimensions: Grinding groove for Ø18-50: width 2.5mm, depth R 1.6, tolerance ±0.1mm
Grinding groove for Ø51-80: width 3mm, depth R 1.6, tolerance ±0.2mm
Grinding groove for Ø81-125: width 4.5mm, depth R 2.5, tolerance ±0.3mm
Grinding groove for Ø>125: width 7mm, depth R4.0, tolerance variable
Thread relief groove: A = 3.3-5.0mm, B = 1.2-1.5mm, T1 = 0.2-1.5mm, T2 = 1.2-2.4mm depending on pitch P
tolerances: Grinding groove depth tolerance: ±0.1mm to ±0.4mm depending on size
Thread relief groove positional tolerance relative to shoulder
inspection: Verify groove dimensions according to diameter range
Check groove depth and width against UNI4386 or TRASMITAL specifications
Verify thread relief groove geometry at shoulder intersections
Confirm groove details are properly indicated in drawing details
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves facilitate grinding operations by providing tool clearance
Grooves prevent interference at shoulders during grinding
Thread relief grooves must be executed where threaded zones meet shoulders with ledge function
Standard groove geometry defined by diameter ranges
Angle of grinding groove typically 30° from vertical
Specific non-standard grooves require detailed drawing callouts
training_guidance: NX agent must recognize when relief grooves are required: at grinding zones and thread terminations at shoulders
Agent should auto-select groove dimensions based on shaft diameter range per TAB-001 table
For Ø18-50mm shafts: apply 2.5mm wide × R1.6 groove with ±0.1mm tolerance
For Ø51-80mm shafts: apply 3mm wide × R1.6 groove with ±0.2mm tolerance
For Ø81-125mm shafts: apply 4.5mm wide × R2.5 groove with ±0.3mm tolerance
For Ø>125mm shafts: apply 7mm wide × R4.0 groove
Agent must insert thread relief groove at shoulder interfaces where threads terminate with ledge function
Thread relief groove geometry must scale with thread pitch: R = 1.2×P (fine), 1.6×P (medium), 2.0×P (coarse)
Generate 60° groove angle and depth parameter 3.2∠R for thread reliefs
Agent should validate that groove details are called out in drawing annotations
Compare generated groove against UNI4386 standard geometry
Flag any non-standard groove requirements for manual engineering review
summary: This page defines relief groove standards for grinding zones (TAB-001) and thread terminations (TAB-002). Grinding relief grooves follow UNI4386 with dimensions scaled by shaft diameter (18mm to >125mm), featuring widths from 2.5-7mm and radii from R1.6 to R4.0. Thread relief grooves are required where threads meet shoulders, with 60° angle and dimensions proportional to thread pitch (P). All groove geometry must be detailed in drawings per Bonfiglioli/TRASMITAL specifications.
